intent: Extend the existing CAP-0003 semantic catalog so mainstream digital-storage quantities can be represented, normalized and compared without ad-hoc unit additions or case-folding ambiguity. Preserve exact canonical symbols for SI decimal and IEC binary units, add explicit aliases only where they are unambiguous, reuse core.unit_conversion_versions as a sparse authoritative conversion graph, derive inverse/transitive conversions in the runtime snapshot, and fail closed on ambiguous aliases, cross-dimension edges or inconsistent conversion paths. Keep CAP-0007 as the execution owner and resume the TrendForce Evidence cursor after this bounded semantic-infrastructure repair.
rationale_summary: The first storage-volume Reality exposed a real EB catalog gap. A one-off EB row is not durable enough for TB/PB/EB, TiB/PiB/EiB and bit-oriented sources, while the current runtime lower-cases unit codes and would make byte/bit symbols unsafe. Reuse CAP-0003's existing units, versioned conversions and semantic fingerprint: exact canonical symbols, explicit aliases, sparse same-dimension edges, graph closure/consistency checks, and fail-closed handling for unknown or ambiguous unit text. CAP-0007 remains the execution owner; no parallel units subsystem is added.
